name_en: Kate meshi — rice mixed with simmered vegetables and fish cake
summary_ja: 煮た干ししいたけやごぼう、ちくわなどをごはんに混ぜ込む相模原市の郷土料理。米が貴重だった土地で量をかさ増しする知恵から生まれたとされ、祭りや彼岸のごちそうとして食べられてきた。
summary_en: A Sagamihara City dish of rice mixed with simmered shiitake mushrooms, burdock and chikuwa fish cake. Said to have grown from the need to stretch precious rice, it is reportedly served as a festive dish at festivals and equinox gatherings.
source_title: かて飯 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ume gohan — rice cooked with pickled plum and dried whitebait
summary_ja: 梅干しとちりめんじゃこを混ぜ込んで炊く小田原市の郷土料理。城下に植えられた梅の実を旅人が重宝した歴史を持つ土地で、地元の食生活指導士が考案し家庭料理として広まったと伝わる。
summary_en: An Odawara City rice dish cooked with pickled plums and dried whitebait mixed in. In a region where plums planted around the castle town were long valued by traveling merchants, it is said to have been devised by a local food educator and spread as a home dish.
source_title: 梅ごはん 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Nara chameshi — rice cooked with chestnuts and red beans in green tea
summary_ja: 米に栗や小豆を入れて煎茶で炊き込む川崎市の郷土料理。東海道川崎宿の茶屋で提供され旅人に好評を博したとされ、『東海道中膝栗毛』にも登場して全国に名が知られたと伝わる。
summary_en: A Kawasaki City dish of rice cooked with chestnuts and red beans in green tea. Said to have been served at a teahouse along the Tokaido post town of Kawasaki-juku to great acclaim from travelers, it became nationally known after appearing in the comic novel Tokaidochu Hizakurige.
source_title: 奈良茶飯 神奈川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
